data.name: Nothing Headphones
data.description: Nothing Headphone (1) is an over-ear wireless headphone with Nothing's signature transparent design. Its 40 mm dynamic drivers, adaptive active noise cancellation, and transparency mode help tailor the listening experience to your surroundings. Hi-Res Audio Wireless and LDAC support enable high-quality music playback. Enjoy up to 80 hours of playback without ANC. The headphones feature microphones for calls and physical controls. Available in black and white.
data.characteristics:
Type: Over-ear wireless headphones
Drivers: 40 mm dynamic + 8 mm planar
Frequency response: 20 Hz-40 kHz
Noise cancellation: Hybrid adaptive ANC, up to 42 dB
Transparency mode: Yes
Bluetooth: 5.3
Audio codecs: AAC, SBC, LDAC
Battery life: Up to 80 hours without ANC
Connectivity: Bluetooth, USB-C, 3.5 mm
Protection rating: IP52
Weight: 329 g
Colors: Black, white.
data.shortCharacteristics: Over-ear wireless Nothing Headphone (1) headphones with 40 mm dynamic drivers, adaptive active noise cancellation, and transparency mode.
data.shortDescription: Hi-Res Audio Wireless and LDAC support. Up to 80 hours of playback without active noise cancellation.
